title: No-Bake Pumpkin Pie with Cream Cheese
description: This no-bake pumpkin pie with cream cheese filling couldn't be easier -- it takes just 5 ingredients, a little prep time, and a couple of hours in the fridge to set before serving.

steps.text: Combine 1/2 cup plus 2 tablespoons pumpkin puree with pumpkin pie spice in a small bowl.

Beat cream cheese and honey in a large bowl with an electric mixer until smooth. Mix in 1/2 cup of the spiced pumpkin mixture and pour into the graham cracker crust; smooth to fill. Spoon remaining spiced pumpkin on top of filled pie and swirl lightly to create a design that mixes with the very top of the filling.
Cover and refrigerate until firm, about 2 hours.

video.description: This is the only pumpkin pie recipe you’ll need this fall. In this video, Nicole shows you how to make no-bake pumpkin pie with an easy homemade filling that comes together on the stovetop in just 10 minutes. For some pumpkin pie cheesecake vibes, this recipe also features a graham cracker crust that lets you show off the very best of both worlds. Once refrigerated and set, top with fresh whipped cream and freshly grated nutmeg, then enjoy every perfect bite of this quintessential fall dessert.
